requirements.summary: Pin maps of U1 (SOT-223 GND/VO/VI), U2, Q1 and PS1 look consistent. J3 uses a 2x03 footprint with a 1x06 symbol, so physical pin order is not the symbol's linear order. Relay datasheet text was unreadable.
EN has pull-up R1 to 3V3, GPIO0 pull-up R3 (with SW1 to GND), GPIO2 pull-up R4, GPIO15 pull-down R5, RST pull-up R2. These levels are correct for normal flash boot.

U1 is an AMS1117-1.8 driving the +3V3 rail, which powers the ESP-12F (VCC 2.7-3.6 V). The module will see 1.8 V and will not operate. The schematic symbol is AMS1117-3.3 while the value and the LCSC part (C6186) differ, so a part-number mismatch is likely as well.

RV1 is a 07D221K varistor (about 140 Vac max) across 230 V mains. It will conduct or burn out in normal operation; a 07D471K or similar is needed. The 500 mA fuse protects only the PS1 branch, not the 16 A relay load path.

Most values are plausible: 1k base resistor with 10k pull-down, 220R blue LED resistor, 1k red LED resistor. Open concerns: J1 is a MKDS 1.5 terminal (typically about 8 A) used for a 16 A relay load, and the 1N4148W flyback diode is acceptable for the 5 V coil.

The relay footprint is G2RL-1A-E while the part is G5RL-1A-E-HR, and the Omron datasheet could not be text-extracted. The footprint match could not be confirmed. The varistor and fuse MPNs were also not checkable.

extra_findings.text: error: U1's schematic symbol is Regulator_Linear:AMS1117-3.3, but the value is AMS1117-1.8. The net is named +3V3, so the intended part is almost certainly the 3.3 V variant.
warning: The load path (J1/L_IN to relay K1) bypasses fuse F1, which sits only in series with PS1 and RV1. A short in the switched load is unprotected. [unverified]
